mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_orders ( ORDER_NO, USER_NO, BRANCH_ID, ORDER_STATUS, BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS, TOTAL_ITEM_AMOUNT, SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM, DELIVERY_FEE, DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT, RECEIVER_NAME, RECEIVER_PHONE, ZIP_CODE, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, ORDER_MEMO, ORDERED_AT, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userNo}, #{branchId}, #{orderStatus}, #{branchDepositStatus}, #{totalItemAmount}, #{supplyPriceSum}, #{deliveryFee}, #{discountAmount}, #{totalPayAmount}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{zipCode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, #{orderMemo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{registerNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updusrNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO tb_order_items ( ORDER_ID, BRANCH_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, OPTION_NAME, UNIT_PRICE, SUPPLY_PRICE, SALE_PRICE, QUANTITY, TOTAL_PRICE, DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, FINAL_PRICE, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{branchId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{optionName}, #{unitPrice}, #{supplyPrice}, #{salePrice}, #{quantity}, #{totalPrice}, #{discountAmount}, #{finalPrice}, #{registerNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updusrNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_orders SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, PAID_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} IN ('30', '50') AND PAID_AT IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE PAID_AT END, CANCELLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} IN ('40', '89') AND CANCELLED_AT IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE CANCELLED_AT END, CANCEL_REASON = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} IN ('40', '80') THEN #{cancelReason} ELSE CANCEL_REASON END, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

UPDATE tb_orders SET TOTAL_ITEM_AMOUNT = #{totalItemAmount}, SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM = #{supplyPriceSum}, TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT = #{totalPayAmount}, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT O.*, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID = 'R010660' AND CODE = O.DELIVERY_COMPANY_CODE) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY_NM, P.PAYMENT_ID, P.PG_TID FROM tb_orders O LEFT JOIN tb_payments P ON O.ORDER_ID = P.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}

SELECT O.*, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID = 'R010660' AND CODE = O.DELIVERY_COMPANY_CODE) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY_NM, P.PAYMENT_ID, P.PG_TID FROM tb_orders O LEFT JOIN tb_payments P ON O.ORDER_ID = P.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_payments ( ORDER_ID, BRANCH_ID, USER_NO, PAYMENT_STATUS, PAYMENT_METHOD, PG_PROVIDER, PG_TID, TOSS_PAYMENT_KEY, TOSS_MID, MERCHANT_UID, AMOUNT_TOTAL, AMOUNT_TAX_FREE, AMOUNT_VAT, CURRENCY, CARD_COMPANY, CARD_NUMBER_MASKED, CARD_INSTALLMENT_MONTH, RECEIPT_URL, PAID_AT, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{branchId}, #{userNo}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{pgProvider}, #{pgTid}, #{tossPaymentKey}, #{tossMid}, #{merchantUid}, #{amountTotal}, #{amountTaxFree}, #{amountVat}, #{currency}, #{cardCompany}, #{cardNumberMasked}, #{cardInstallmentMonth}, #{receiptUrl}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{registerNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updusrNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_payments SET PAYMENT_STATUS = #{paymentStatus}, CANCELLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{paymentStatus} = '40' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE CANCELLED_AT END, FAIL_CODE = #{failCode}, FAIL_MESSAGE = #{failMessage}, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PG_TID = #{pgTid} OR MERCHANT_UID = #{merchantUid}
